question: How can I add a Profile page to my Members Area using the Wix Editor?
candidate_answer:

- Open the Wix Editor and go to the Pages and Menu section on the left side.

question: Can I get a refund for a logo purchased from Wix Logo Maker if I cancel my Logo + Website plan within 14 days?
candidate_answer: No, you cannot get a refund for the logo files if you cancel your Logo + Website plan within 14 days. You are only entitled to a refund for the site subscription portion. Additionally, any discount applied to the logo files will be revoked and deducted from your subscription refund. In some cases where the logo price exceeds the plan price, no refund will be issued at all [S1].

Any logos that you purchase from Wix Logo are non-refundable as these are digital goods, and we cannot monitor their use after download.Cancelling a Logo + Website planA Logo + Website plan comes with a website. If you cancel your Logo + Website within 14 days of purchase, in accordance with our Terms of Use, you will only be entitled to a refund for your site subscription and not for your Logo files. Any discount you received with your plan for your Logo files will be revoked and deducted from the amount refunded to you for your subscription. In some cases, the logo files price is higher than the plan price. In these cases, you will not receive a refund.Notes: If you cancel an Unlimited or Business Logo + Website plan, you will still have use of the benefits of the Advanced Logo Maker plan. gt_answer: Logos purchased from Wix Logo are **non-refundable** as they are digital goods, and we cannot monitor their use after download. If you cancel your Logo + Website plan within 14 days of purchase, you will only be entitled to a refund for your site subscription and not for your Logo files. Any discount you received with your plan for your Logo files will be revoked and deducted from the amount refunded to you for your subscription. In some cases, the logo files price is higher than the plan price. In these cases, you will not receive a refund.

question: How can I add and set up a range slider in my CMS to filter content by a number value?
candidate_answer:
To add and set up a range slider in your CMS to filter content by a number value, follow these steps:

- Click the **Connect to CMS** icon on the range slider element.
- In the **Connect Range Slider** panel, select **Filter content**.
- Choose the dataset connected to the elements you want to filter (e.g., repeater, gallery, table) from the **Choose a dataset** drop-down.
- From the **Filter content by** drop-down, select the number field that visitors will use for filtering.
- If the number field does not exist, select **Add new field**, enter the field name, and click **Add**. You can then add content to this field in your CMS collection.
- Set the filtering condition by selecting from the **Condition** drop-down:
  - **Between**: shows items with values between the range slider handles.
  - **Outside of**: shows items with values outside the range slider handles.

This setup allows visitors to filter content dynamically based on the number value range they select with the slider [S1].

[1] CMS: Adding and Setting Up a Range Slider
Click the Connect to CMS icon  on the range slider.  Select Filter content in the Connect Range Slider panel on the right.  Click the Choose a dataset drop-down and select the same dataset that connects to the elements (e.g. repeater, gallery, table) that you want visitors to filter.  Click the Filter content by drop-down and choose the number field that visitors will use to filter the content. Tip: To add a new field to your collection and use it for filtering content, select Add new field, then enter the field name and click Add. You can add content to the field in your CMS collection later.  Click the Condition drop-down and select the relevant condition:

Between: Show items that have a connected number field value that is between the range slider handles. Outside of: Show items that have a connected number field value that is outside of the range slider handles.

question: How can I restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs?
candidate_answer:
You cannot directly restore an archived program in Wix Online Programs. Instead, you need to duplicate the archived program and publish the new draft. The steps are:

- Go to Online Programs in your site's dashboard.
- Click the Archived tab.
- Click the More Actions icon next to the archived program.
- Select Duplicate.
- The duplicated program will appear in the Drafts tab.
- From the Drafts tab, use the More Actions icon to publish or edit the new program.

This process effectively recreates the archived program as a new draft since restoration is not supported [S1].

question: How can I review reports about members from my site's dashboard?

2. Click **Sales**.
3. Select the **Orders** tab.

Once you are in the Orders tab, you can perform all the actions on a subscription order (fulfill the order, add a tracking number, cancel it, etc.) just as you would a one-time order. Information about the subscription appears on the order page. Click **View Subscription** in the order to manage the subscription, such as updating the address. Learn more about [managing a product subscription](https://support.wix.com/en/article/wix-stores-managing-product-subscriptions).
